theorems.name: Submission.idod_uniform_ball_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (K K'' : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ σ₀ θ₁ θ₂ : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 ≤ Λ → 0 < σ₀ → θ₁ < θ₂ → (∀ y ∈ K, ∃ θ : ℝ, θ < θ₁ ∧ HasMassDensity T y θ) → (∀ y ∈ K, closedBall y (2 * σ₀) ⊆ K'') → (∀ (y : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), closedBall y R ⊆ K'' → MonotoneOn (fun ρ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (Λ * ρ) / ρ ^ n) * T.massOn (ball y ρ)) (Ioo 0 R)) → ∃ ρ₀ : ℝ, 0 < ρ₀ ∧ ∀ y ∈ K, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < ρ₀ → T.massOn (ball y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal θ₂ * unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
